stable_id_authority: Local design proposal; not an exchange identifier or ISIN
layers: Immutable supplier symbol and original row key
Evidence-versioned supplier alias to stable security identity
Independent index-membership events linked through identity

transition.effective_boundary_text: 2025-02-17 market open, as declared by issuer
transition.same_listed_entity_basis: Issuer source states listed entity continues; full security-master and capital/reorganization history remain unqualified

supplier_alias.historical_code_conflict: New exchange symbol used in pre-2025-02-17 delivered history; retain raw label and stage a separate mapping, never overwrite rows

projection_to_existing_contract: IdentitySnapshot accepts explicit inclusive intervals and available_at. UNKNOWN bounds/availability are not converted into a formal snapshot; do not invent a previous trading day.
rejection_rules: Reject a PIT symbol not valid for its date
Reject unavailable_at or unknown original listing identity
Do not infer CSI500 membership from a code transition
